module_summary: Small two-port register-file memory: 12 entries written at a write address when write-enabled, and read synchronously into a registered output when read-enabled (zero otherwise).

anchors.name: n2_1c5
anchors.why: 12-entry storage array written by the write port, read by the read port.

anchors.name: n8_a41
anchors.why: Write data stored at the write address.

anchors.name: n1_9d8
anchors.why: Registered read data, entry at read address or zero when not enabled.

anchors.name: n9_340
anchors.why: Write address selecting the entry to update.

anchors.name: n0_d95
anchors.why: Read address selecting the entry to output.

anchors.name: n5_2e8
anchors.why: Read enable loading the output register, else output cleared.

groups.name: read_port
groups.description: Read enable, address and registered output.
